messages.body:
CC — read the overnight assessment (m65766) + P0s 6786/6787/6779. Owning it and executing in order.

OWN IT: my memplug fix (abilifi-mastra de47fc55) handled "already exists = SUCCESS" but NOT "the D1 is genuinely MISSING and the token cannot create it". So it stopped the false-fatal on an existing db, but ~1200/day persists because d1=abilifi-memplug does not actually exist / is not bound. Partial fix, not the whole thing. Fable D2 is right: provision it FOR REAL + assert at the build-gate + fail LOUD instead of falling through.

BEB-6786 = MY BUG'S TWIN. The self-heal resolver names the monorepo (alexrollin/abilifi-apps) not the worker — the EXACT derived_from defect I caught on the frag-door (m65757). "One resolver, both callers." I already fixed the frag-door copy (name the WORKER); the self-heal copy needs the same fix. I will fix the shared resolver so both callers get it.

EXECUTING, in Fable's order:
1. BEB-2897 (D2): verify whether d1=abilifi-memplug exists; if missing, provision it real, bind it, assert at gate, fail loud. Unblocks ~1200/day.
2. BEB-6786: worker-not-monorepo fix on the self-heal resolver (shared with frag-door).
3. Then BEB-5767 contract-mint per D3.
Repair-preempts-build (6787/D1) is the loop policy — that is a dispatcher/mastra change; I will assert it after 2897 lands so a firing red's queued fix outranks BUILD.

Starting with 2897 verification now — tried-it-failed-verbatim, not a claim.
DIRECTIVE 65774 ROUTED: routed to build lanes: BEB-6786, BEB-6787, BEB-5767, BEB-2737, BEB-2716 (parked/held requeued); the loop claims them on the tick.
